description.en: Sets the "open width" parameter of a character's silhouette outline effect (see CMND_SET_CHARA_SIL_WIDTH), controlling how the outline expands/animates in. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.

example.code:
// Animate a character's silhouette outline opening wider
CMND_SET_CHARA_SIL_OPENWIDTH(hChara, 1.5);
